newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK DEP'S 96 PROFIT UP 65PCT TO 11BLN DRS - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: GREEK DEP'S 96 PROFIT UP 65PCT TO 11BLN DRS - REPORT.

text.p: Greek state Public Petroleum Corporation (DEP) which the government plans to part-float this year, had pretax profits of 11 billion drachmas, up 65 percent on 1995, private Multipress said in a statement.
DEP's sales rose 29 percent or 103.8 billion drachmas to 461.7 billion drachmas in 1996, it said.
DEP's consolidated profits rose 45 percent to 34.5 billion drachmas, it added.

All figures come from CD-ROM "Greek industry and Economy" which reviews developments in 1,200 Greek industrial companies produced by Multipress. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
